jobs.title: Trust Strategy & Operations
jobs.jd_full:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As part of the trust team, you'll collaborate across functions to design and implement systems that streamline trust workflows, enhance decision-making around risk, and support responsible growth. The team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners — including Product, Operations, Legal, Marketing, and Engineering — to drive accountability, insights, and operational integrity across the business.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • End-to-End Process Management — Build and maintain strategic automations and standardized processes that support trust and safety functions, promoting consistency and adoption across the org.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration — Partner with Engineering and Growth teams to drive initiatives that enhance trust infrastructure and operational effectiveness.

  • Leadership Partnership — Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership, delivering strategic insights, risk reporting, and actionable recommendations.

  • Data-Driven Strategy — Oversee analytics across trust functions. Identify risk patterns and areas for improvement; build dashboards and insights that inform policy decisions and guide operational improvements.

  • Reporting & Analytics — Lead the design and management of dashboards, reports, and KPIs that measure trust and safety performance and impact.

Who you are

  • Passionate about responsible AI and motivated by building systems that protect users and maintain platform integrity

  • Highly motivated with a strong work ethic — you understand the stakes of this moment in AI and are committed to getting it right

  • Analytical and first-principles oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity and complex risk tradeoffs

  • Consistently deliver high-quality work quickly and take initiative from day one

  • Low ego, high ownership

Requirements

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to translate complex risk data into clear recommendations

  • 4+ years in Security, Trust & Safety Operations, or Risk Operations at a high-growth technology company

  • Proven track record building end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis through to execution

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Policy, Legal, or Safety teams

  • Highly adaptable with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe. Preference for candidates based in London.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.jd_full:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is hiring exceptional Revenue Operations analysts who will support a team of experts growing and managing our global direct, alliance, channel partner and online sales. The Revenue Operations teams drive continuous policy, process and data quality improvement which enable us to analyze and drive interventions to maximize net customer retention, and lead robust, repeatable processes to plan, manage and deliver revenue.

You will support the leadership of the team, providing insights to drive improvements and partnering with Canonical’s teams across sales, business development, customer success, marketing, product management, commercial systems, delivery, finance and legal. This position requires an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the desire to strive for excellence. People that thrive in these roles are proactive problem solvers who are passionate about collaborating with sales and business development teams, our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and contributing to initiatives in support of Canonical's continued success. Successful candidates will demonstrate initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.

Location: These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA and Americas regions

The role entails

  • Supporting all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales and business development functions globally
  • Driving data quality, through checking opportunities for accuracy, clean order processing, new hire training, policy and process documentation, reporting and data cleansing
  • Supporting and enabling the sales team globally on CRM and other revenue operations policies, processes and systems such as Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement, Data Enrichment, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions
  • Supporting other Revenue Operations Analysts and leadership team to report on and improve data quality, sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks.
  • Supporting planning, monitoring and improving revenue operations, across new leads, pipeline, velocity, sales productivity and renewals. Delivering insight that enables improved territory and quota management, channel development and sales productivity.
  • Assisting the team with automation and streamlining of the end-to-end Lead to Order process

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a related field, preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Experience working as an analyst in revenue/sales operations or related fields such as financial analysis, sales analysis or sales order processing
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent attention to detail and data-driven, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Planning and organisational skills, including the ability to interact and work with stakeholders across functions and at all levels of the organisation
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills, including comfort working with teams under commercial pressure
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel internationally up to four times a year for company events

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience gained within a similar, technology subscription-based business
  • Understanding of working in a global, multicultural organization including within a team based remotely in multiple time zones

What Canonical offers

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Director of Global Field Operations
jobs.jd_full:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

Sonatype is looking for a Director of Field Strategy & Operations to serve as a high-level operational partner to our field leadership and help us scale the way our global field organization operates through an AI Ops and modern Revenue approach.

This role reports directly to the Chief Revenue Officer and is ideally based on the West Coast to support APJ overlap, with a global remit across Sonatype’s field organisation.

Sonatype is building the next phase of its commercial operating model: a more focused, repeatable enterprise growth engine for Global 2000 and $5bn+ revenue organisations. We sell through direct new-logo acquisition, expansion and cross-sell within existing customers, and channel/partner routes to market. This leader will help make those motions work together with greater pace, rigour and consistency globally.

This is a builder role. You will not inherit a finished operating model and simply maintain it. You will diagnose where the organisation is losing momentum, design the mechanisms that improve execution, and establish the commercial cadence, accountability and cross-functional alignment required to scale.

You will work alongside Revenue Operations, Enablement and Sales Strategy as a close commercial partner—not duplicate or impede their mandates. Revenue Operations owns the systems, data architecture and operational infrastructure; Enablement owns readiness, capability development and field programmes. This role brings the field perspective to the table: identifying the highest-value execution problems, setting the business cadence and translating commercial priorities into coordinated action across those teams.

This is not a traditional administrative, program management, or reactive Sales Operations role. We are looking for a strategic, AI-minded field operator who functions as a trusted partner to field executives. You will sit at the intersection of Sales, Solutions Consulting, Field Marketing, Enablement, Sales Strategy, Sales Programs, and Revenue Operations, creating the operating discipline, AI-driven insights, and cross-functional alignment required to turn strategy into measurable commercial results.

You will be trusted to step into critical business rhythms—including forecast, pipeline, and strategic performance reviews—leading them with commercial judgement, authority, and data-driven command of the business. By championing an AI Ops approach, you will leverage advanced analytics and AI-enabled revenue tools to identify pipeline bottlenecks, optimize sales execution, establish clear operating cadences, mobilize cross-functional leaders, and drive strategic initiatives through to business outcomes.

As Sonatype continues to grow and evolve its go-to-market organization, this role will also help shape how our field functions operate at scale. Over time, it has the potential to become a natural consolidation point for additional field capabilities and teams.

For someone who enjoys being at the heart of a commercial organization—combining strategy, operating discipline, leadership, and hands-on execution—this is an opportunity to have significant impact.

Responsibilities

  • Shape the Global Field Strategy: Shape the global field strategy with the CRO and senior commercial leaders, ensuring territory, account, pipeline, partner and expansion plans are translated into clear field actions and measurable outcomes.

  • Run the Field Operating Rhythm & Strategic Cadence: Partner closely with senior field leadership as an operational right hand to translate commercial strategy into a clear operating agenda. Lead critical business rhythms including forecast, pipeline, performance, and execution reviews, stepping in independently when leadership is unavailable. Ensure commitments made through field operating cadences translate into decisive action and commercial results.

  • Drive Strategic Field Execution: Translate high-level executive priorities into structured, executable programs with clear outcomes, ownership, milestones, and accountability. Leverage an AI Ops approach to eliminate operational drag, unblock stalled initiatives, and maintain cross-functional momentum across global field teams to improve pipeline creation, progression, and productivity.

  • Connect & Align the Field Organization: Operate as a key connector across Sales, Solutions Consulting, Field Marketing, Enablement, Revenue Operations, and Finance to ensure unified alignment around overarching revenue goals. Resolve competing priorities and execution barriers while building strong cross-functional relationships to influence without relying on hierarchy.

  • Strengthen Forecast & Pipeline Rigor: Combine deep commercial understanding with AI intelligence to enhance forecast accuracy, detect deal risks early, and evaluate health across territories and deal stages. Turn raw operational data into actionable revenue strategies and targeted field actions.

  • Build Scalable Field Models: Help design and continuously refine a scalable field operating model capable of supporting Sonatype's growth. Simplify and standardize field processes, establishing repeatable operating practices and leveraging modern AI technology to scale field impact efficiently.

Outcomes

Success in this role will mean that Sonatype's field organization operates with greater clarity, predictability, accountability, and speed. You will help:

  • Improve the quality, coverage and conversion of enterprise pipeline across direct and partner-led motions.

  • Improve the quality and predictability of forecast and pipeline management using AI Ops and revenue intelligence.

  • Increase executive visibility into commercial performance, revenue risks, and emerging growth opportunities.

  • Establish a joined-up operating model across new logo, customer expansion and channel teams.

  • Give field leaders earlier visibility of execution risk, stalled deals, capacity constraints and growth opportunities.

  • Build the operating mechanisms required for a platform-led, value-based and increasingly AI-enabled revenue organisation.

  • Create stronger accountability for strategic field initiatives.

  • Improve the field organization's ability to turn strategy into measurable commercial action.

  • Build scalable operating mechanisms that support continued company growth.

  • Develop a field operations structure capable of absorbing additional responsibilities as the organization evolves.

  • Enable senior field leadership to spend more time on customers, people, strategy, and growth while maintaining confidence that critical operating priorities are moving forward.

Who you are

Essential Experience and Capabilities

  • You have built or materially transformed a field operating model within a complex enterprise software business—not simply administered an established one. You can point to the commercial outcomes you improved, such as pipeline creation, conversion, forecast accuracy, sales productivity, expansion performance or partner contribution.

  • Commercial credibility to work as a peer with senior sales leaders and challenge constructively when required.

  • Deep understanding of enterprise sales operating rhythms, including forecasting, pipeline management, business reviews, territory execution, and performance management.

  • Demonstrated experience personally leading forecast or equivalent commercial operating calls—not simply preparing reporting for others.

  • Experience translating ambiguous executive priorities into structured, cross-functional execution.

  • Strong business judgement and the ability to identify what matters most among competing priorities.

  • Experience driving initiatives across functions where you may not have direct reporting authority.

  • Ability to combine strategic thinking with detailed operational execution.

  • Strong understanding of the relationship between Sales, Solutions Consulting, Marketing, Enablement, Programs, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations.

  • Experience designing or improving operating models as organizations grow.

  • Confidence to make decisions, challenge assumptions, and hold senior stakeholders accountable.

  • Strong analytical capability and the ability to turn data into commercial decisions and action.

  • Experience leading teams and developing high-performing operational or enablement talent.

  • Strong expertise in AI Ops, Revenue Operations, and modern revenue intelligence platforms to drive field productivity, forecasting accuracy, and decision-making leverage.

How You Work

  • Operator First: Does not wait for perfectly defined projects; takes an ambiguous business objective, determines what needs to happen, brings the right people together, and creates momentum.

  • Balanced Perspective: Comfortable being close enough to the business to understand detail while maintaining the strategic perspective required to make enterprise-level trade-offs.

  • Credibility via Execution: Builds influence through judgement and execution rather than process or hierarchy.

  • Constructive Accountability: Willing to challenge respectfully, make decisions when appropriate, and create accountability when progress stalls.

  • Enterprise Mindset: Naturally thinks beyond individual functions and optimizes for the performance of the broader field organization.

  • Outcome Ownership: Instinct is to own outcomes, not simply organize meetings.

Preferred Experience

  • Enterprise cybersecurity, application security, developer tools, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, or enterprise software.

  • Experience supporting a global enterprise sales organization.

  • Experience operating through periods of significant GTM transformation or scale.

  • Experience bringing previously distributed field capabilities into a more integrated operating model.

  • Leadership of Sales Enablement, Field Enablement, Sales Programs, or related functions.

  • Experience partnering with both direct and channel/partner sales organizations.

  • Experience in businesses with complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.

  • Proven experience implementing AI-driven sales/revenue operations tools and methodologies across enterprise field teams.

What success looks like?

  • 30 Days: You will immerse yourself in Sonatype's field organization and commercial model. You will build relationships with key Sales, Solutions Consulting, Marketing, Enablement, Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders and develop a detailed understanding of how the field currently operates. You will observe existing forecast, pipeline, and operating cadences and begin identifying where greater clarity, accountability, or simplification could improve execution. Most importantly, you will establish credibility as someone who understands the business rather than someone who simply manages process.

  • 60 Days: You will begin taking meaningful ownership of key field operating rhythms and strategic initiatives. You will have established a clear view of the most important execution gaps, dependencies, and opportunities across the field organization and will begin implementing improvements with the relevant leaders. You will increasingly operate as a trusted partner to field leadership, capable of taking an ambiguous priority and converting it into an actionable plan.

  • 90 Days: You will be capable of independently running core field operating cadences, including forecast and pipeline conversations. Senior leaders will trust you to represent the state of the business accurately, challenge assumptions appropriately, and drive decisions through to execution. Cross-functional initiatives under your leadership will have clear owners, milestones, accountability, and measurable progress. You will also have developed a point of view on how Sonatype's broader field operating model should evolve as the organization scales.

  • 12 Months: You will have become a critical operational leader within Sonatype's field organization. The business will operate with stronger forecast discipline, better cross-functional alignment, greater execution accountability, and increased visibility into commercial performance. Strategic priorities will move through the organization faster and with clearer ownership. Field leaders will view you as a trusted peer and business partner who can move seamlessly between strategy, commercial judgement, organizational leadership, and hands-on execution. You will also have helped establish a scalable Field Operations model that can serve as a foundation for further consolidation and growth.

Compensation

Additional Information

Things that we are proud of

  • 2024 Built In Best Places to Work: Sonatype was named to the Washington DC 100 Best Places to Work list.

jobs.title: Head of Planning
jobs.jd_full:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Head of Planning

We’re looking for a Head of Planning to join our growing Operations team. You will play a critical role in optimizing Quince’s inventory performance by leading all Inventory Planning and Forecasting functions for a specific area of the business portfolio, TBD. In this role, you will own forecasting and replenishment for your business, driving optimal inventory turns, improve in-stock performance, and maximize return on investment. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant ownership and influence.

Because Quince’s business model is unique, this position will be equally unique in its execution—combining analytical rigor, strategic partnership, and active collaboration with merchandising, sourcing, technology, and vendor teams. This is a hands-on role that requires a high level of performance and execution, aligned with Quince’s operating principles.

Success in this position means working within and building best-in-class forecasting systems that balance product availability with working capital efficiency while supporting Quince’s mission to deliver luxury quality at radically low prices. As a part of the Planning team, this person will play a critical role in shaping future Planning processes at Quince, helping to architect the solutions and capabilities of tomorrow to support our rapid growth.

This role will report directly to a VP of Inventory Planning.

Responsibilities

  • Forecast items at the style-color-size level by week, achieving key performance indicators including in-stock rates, inventory turns, and return on investment.
  • Partner closely with the internal sourcing team and external vendors to collaborate on forecasts and maximize product availability.
  • Work directly with the technology team to develop and implement integrated, intelligent, and automated forecasting solutions.
  • Conduct analytics and root-cause analysis to identify opportunities for KPI improvement.
  • Collaborate with sourcing to model vendor relationships, terms, and risk profiles.
  • Build short-, mid-, and long-range inventory and replenishment plans that align with business strategy.
  • Present forecasts, strategies, and performance updates weekly to executives.
  • Manage and mentor one or more team members as the function scales.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Looking for candidates at the Sr. Manager level or above - Director-level preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in inventory planning, merchandising, or related analytics/technology roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or Master’s in Supply Chain Management preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in advanced Excel statistical functions.
  • Fluency with Google Suite and comfort working with large data sets.
  • Experience prototyping inventory optimization techniques and converting insights into scalable technology.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external partners to maximize opportunities and minimize risks.
  • Strong commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to find, organize, and use data to draw actionable conclusions with minimal assumptions.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment where established processes may not yet exist.

Preferred:

    • Insatiable curiosity and a desire to uncover insights that drive results.
    • Willingness to form and share informed points of view with peers and executives.
    • Ability to pivot quickly and thrive in a dynamic, startup-like environment.

You will be the owner of our project portfolio in Jira, building the structure, cadence, and reporting that keep teams aligned and deliverables on schedule. But what does this role actually do?

  1. Project Management:

    • Track and manage company-wide projects from initiation to completion using Jira.
    • Coordinate with team leads across portfolio management, trading, operations, compliance, legal, marketing and tech to ensure milestones are met.

This remote opportunity is ideal for a steel project management professional who understands the complete structural steel lifecycle and how drawing releases, fabrication schedules, material procurement, and erection sequencing impact overall project performance.

Reporting to the Director of Project Management, the Project Manager will oversee project schedules, budgets, contract administration, client relationships, and execution. This individual will work closely with dedicated preconstruction, detailing, fabrication, purchasing, safety, and project administration teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and profitably.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and general contractors following preconstruction turnover.
  • Coordinate engineering, design teams, and detailing personnel to manage drawing releases, model reviews, RFIs, and submittals.

  • Collaboration with dedicated preconstruction, detailing, fabrication, purchasing, safety, and project administration teams.
